event_time_shape.name: event_time_shape
event_time_shape.value:
("event"."all_day" and "event"."start_date" is not null and "event"."starts_at" is null)
    or (not "event"."all_day" and "event"."starts_at" is not null and "event"."start_date" is null)

alt_or_decorative.name: alt_or_decorative
alt_or_decorative.value: "media"."decorative" or "media"."alt_text" is not null or "media"."mime_type" not like 'image/%'
